question: Who won the Women’s Singles title at the French Open 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Coco Gauff**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Coco Gauff Clinches First French Open Title, Defeats Sabalenka in Grand Slam Final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Coco Gauff**, a **21-year-old American**, won the **2025 French Open Women’s Singles title**.

 
 
• 
 
She defeated **world number one Aryna Sabalenka** in the final: **6-7(5), 6-2, 6-4**.

 
 
• 
 
This is Gauff’s **first French Open title** and **second Grand Slam victory** (after the **2023 US Open**).

 
 
• 
 
She became the **first American woman** to win the **French Open singles title** since **Serena Williams in 2015**.

 
 
• 
 
Gauff is the **youngest American** to win the title since **Serena in 2002**.

 
 
• 
 
This was the **first Grand Slam final on clay** for **Sabalenka**, and her **third consecutive Slam final** overall.

 
 
• 
 
It was also the **first meeting of world number 1 and 2** in a Grand Slam final since the **2018 Australian Open**.

 
 
• 
 
Gauff now has Slam titles on **both hard and clay courts**.
